items.text: Remove spaces inserted between CJK characters in transcript output

comments.text: Closed via commit 9bebc5d. Root cause: helpers.py:381 unconditionally appended `wrd + " "` after every word. Fix: added _is_cjk + _append_word helpers, CJK-aware join. Regression test: tests/test_helpers.py (26 cases). Full suite 97/97 green.

meta.originalText: remove spaces from transcript containing CJK characters. Currently, obtained transcript using server.py have spaces between CJK characters (e.g. Chinese, Japanese)

items.description:
**Problem:** Transcripts produced via `server.py` contain spurious spaces between CJK characters (e.g. Chinese, Japanese).
**Expected:** CJK characters in the transcript should appear without inserted spaces.
**Actual:** Obtained transcripts currently have spaces inserted between CJK characters.
**Context:** Reproducible via `server.py` transcript output.
